action_items: FIX MOBILE LAYOUT: in /app/frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx line 255, the inner div with h-[60vh] is constraining the entire MapPanel (which now contains BOTH the map AND the mobile-info-panel). Options: (a) Change inner wrapper to className="lg:flex-1 lg:h-auto lg:min-h-0 relative" (i.e. remove h-[60vh] on mobile so MapPanel grows to natural height) and let MapPanel.jsx control the map's own 60vh internally via its child div. MapPanel already does this — its inner map wrapper at line 142 should switch from 'flex-1 min-h-[400px] md:min-h-0' to 'h-[60vh] md:flex-1 md:min-h-0' on mobile so the map keeps 60vh while the panel flows below naturally. (b) Alternative: pull the mobile-info-panel block out of MapPanel.jsx and render it as a sibling in Dashboard.jsx between the h-[60vh] map wrapper and the Timeline.
After fix, verify on 390x844 that: map=0..~506, panel=506..~781 (titre+coords+boutons+légende all visible), Timeline=781..~912 below the panel (may push below the fold but reachable by scroll).
Optional: add data-testid="timeline" on the Timeline root for clearer selector targeting in future tests.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx grid uses lg:overflow-hidden on the dashboard-root which is fine on desktop but the section h-auto on mobile relies on natural flow — yet the inner h-[60vh] div clips/visually-conflicts because Timeline is its sibling, not a child. Either the panel must be a sibling of the h-[60vh] div, or the constraint must move inside MapPanel.

MapPanel.jsx currently mixes two concerns: map (absolute overlays) and mobile-info-panel (flow). The flow-block rendering inside the same root that is also constrained-height by parent will keep producing overlap bugs. Recommend splitting: <MapPanel /> renders only the leaflet+overlays, and <MapMobileInfoPanel /> renders below as a sibling.

Two <WeatherLayersPanel> instances rendered (one mobile inline, one desktop absolute via hideOnMobile). Acceptable but slightly duplicates DOM + state subscribers. Confirmed DOM count=2, visible count=1 per viewport — OK functionally.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop 1600x900 is fully validated: mobile-info-panel=display:none, all desktop overlays visible (Zone surveillée top-6 left-6 display:block, map-legend display:block, WeatherLayersPanel visible once, TrajectoryBadge at top:220 right:24), toggle Trajet correctly mounts/unmounts the badge. The MOBILE failure is a layout/CSS issue, not a missing-component issue: every DOM node exists and panel.innerText contains 'ZONE SURVEILLÉE / Lourdes · 20 km / 43.0951°N · -0.0434°E / NUAGES PLUIE VENT TRAJET / TRAJECTOIRE / LÉGENDE / Zone calme / Zone convective / Zone orageuse / Impact foudre'. The panel sits at y=400..675 inside a parent constrained to y=0..506, and Timeline at y=506..637 covers the panel's lower half. Reproduction: viewport 390x844, goto /, evaluate getBoundingClientRect on [data-testid=mobile-info-panel] and the second child of [data-testid=map-area]. After fix, re-run the same evaluate and assert timeline.top >= panel.bottom.
rca of the issue: Dashboard.jsx puts MapPanel inside a height-constrained container (h-[60vh] on mobile) and renders Timeline as its sibling immediately below. MapPanel now renders the mobile-info-panel as an in-flow block inside its own root, which OVERFLOWS the h-[60vh] cap (overflow visible by default). The visual result: panel content > 506px is drawn but the section's NEXT child (Timeline) is positioned at y=506 in the parent grid flow, overlapping the panel's lower portion. Mitigation: either move the h-[60vh] constraint from Dashboard's wrapper down INTO MapPanel's inner map div only, or hoist the mobile-info-panel out of MapPanel and into Dashboard between the map wrapper and Timeline.
